method: Each size uses the production layoutName function with a common 145 mm comparison line (independent of the plinth). Vertically tall or multi-line names can pass a feature check while exceeding the front band. Nonselected fonts are research only. See lettering-matrix.json for selected-face actual plinth and mesh tests.
variants: Noto and Oswald numeric suffixes are instantiated variable-axis weights. Heiti-80 is a 0.08 em stroke with 16-sided round caps/joins and NonZero overlapping contours. Other -0 suffixes are static corpus subsets. Source SHA-256 identifies original unmodified input data, except historical assets and the explicitly identified finished VibeSkyline Grid derivative.
